title: Nearest Products by Embedding
statement: The `products` table (columns: id INT, name TEXT, embedding vector(3)) is pre-seeded with 4 rows. Using pgvector's `<->` (L2 distance) operator, write a query that returns `id` and `name` for ALL products, ordered from closest to farthest from the vector [1,0,0].
starter_code:
-- Write your query below
SELECT id, name FROM products
-- ORDER BY ...
;
hints: The <-> operator computes L2 (Euclidean) distance between two vectors
ORDER BY embedding <-> '[1,0,0]' sorts rows by distance to that vector
